name: Strategy bot planning order (alternate)
_alternate: Changed from the standard order (GC72_PrimaryOrder): (1) a second Fill defensive gaps among the final steps, after every other objective has placed its units but BEFORE Pursue leftovers -- so a territory an earlier objective emptied is garrisoned again, with first call on the money Pursue leftovers would otherwise spend on attacks; (2) planner_options (engine/bots/strategy_settings.py PLANNER_OPTIONS): aircraft bought into sea zones come with a carrier place, Control Oceans buys no Mechanized Infantry, an SC pursuit across the sea buys Mechanized Infantry first, with a warship escort in any sea zone it's bought into, and no objective takes the last unit out of a threatened territory unless something replaces it. Every other step and share as the standard order's.
_note: The planner works through `steps` in order, each after taking `budget_share` of its planning budget; treasonous_capture only runs when the bot means to betray its alliance this turn. The secondary objectives come next (each taking secondary_budget_share, in an order drawn by the strategy weights), then `final`.
